died.name: Thomas Midgley Jr.
died.cause: The 55-year-old American chemical engineer, best known for inventing leaded gasoline and chlorofluorocarbon gas, contracted polio in 1941, which left him severely disabled, leading him to devise an elaborate system of ropes and pulleys to lift himself out of bed. In 1944, he became entangled in the device and died of strangulation.

died.name: George Bernard Shaw
died.last_words: Sister, you're trying to keep me alive as an old curiosity, but I'm done, I'm finished, I'm going to die.

died.name: Lester Roloff
died.desc: American fundamentalist Independent Baptist preacher and founder of teen homes
died.last_words: I believe this is going to be the greatest day of my life!

died.name: Velma Barfield
died.last_words: I know that everybody has gone through a lot of pain, all the families connected, and I am sorry, and I want to thank everybody who have been supporting me all these six years.

born.name: Daniel Boone
born.last_words: I'm going now. My time has come.

born.name: Pierre Pigneau de Behaine
born.desc: French Roman Catholic priest and missionary in Vietnam
born.last_words: Here I am finally. Here I am at the end of the tumultuous career that, whatever my repugnance, I have kept to for so long. My troubles will soon be over and my true happiness is coming, since I have all confidence in the mercy of my God. I willingly leave this world where I have been thought happy in that I have had public admiration, been respected by great, esteemed kings. I can't say that I regret all these honors-it's just that they add up to vanity and trouble.

born.name: Marie Antoinette
born.cause: apologizing to her executioner for stepping on his foot prior to her execution by guillotine
born.last_words: Pardon me, sir. I did not do it on purpose.

born.name: Adrienne de La Fayette
born.cause: French marchioness who married Marquis de Lafayette

born.name: James K. Polk
born.cause: to his wife, Sarah Childress Polk
born.last_words: I love you, Sarah. For all eternity, I love you.

born.name: Soapy Smith
born.desc: con artist and gangster in the American frontier
born.cause: after vigilante Frank H. Reid shot him

born.name: Warren G. Harding
born.cause: to his wife, Florence Harding, who had been reading aloud a flattering Saturday Evening Post article about him
born.last_words: That's good. Go on, read some more.

born.name: Cecil Pugh
born.cause: asking to be lowered into the hold of the sinking SS Anselm, where injured airmen were trapped. Pugh then prayed with the men until the ship sank
born.last_words: My love of God is greater than my fear of death.

born.name: Gerry Richardson
born.cause: to PC Carl Walker, GC, referring to armed robber Frederick Joseph Sewell, who had shot both of them. Walker survived
born.last_words: I had him by the throat but the bastard shot me.
